name: g_partySaveWorkStorage
comment: Static BSS backing store for the 0xE3C8-byte party/save work container; the object itself starts at the next 16-byte boundary 0x007F52F0. It is built once by the lazy accessor at 0x006F1F88 (flag 0x007BE304, holder *0x007BE308, base ctor 0x00103594, derived vtable 0x00782964), whose ctor runs Save_InitPartySnapshot and builds the 0xFF-slot and 31-member sub-arrays.
evidence: 0x006F1F88 memsets 0xE3C8 bytes at ALIGN_UP(0x007F52E4,16)=0x007F52F0 and calls 0x00103594 (maybe_SaveWork_Container_BaseCtor: base vtables 0x007602B4/0x007602CC, Save_InitPartySnapshot); size plus pad ends at 0x008036B8, just before 0x008036BC.

name: g_gameDataManagerStorage
comment: Static BSS backing store for the 0xA24-byte GameData/DataManager singleton (object at 0x008036C0); accessor Game_GetDataManager 0x0011CB38 (flag 0x007BE30C, holder *0x007BE310, vtable 0x00782990, ctor 0x0011CFDC). It owns the master records (items, spells, skills, messages, actions, maps) that every 0x63xxxx lookup takes as its first argument.
evidence: Game_GetDataManager (0x0011CB38) memsets 0xA24 bytes at ALIGN_UP(0x008036BC,16)=0x008036C0, runs ctor 0x0011CFDC and stores vtable 0x00782990 into *0x007BE310. The block is inlined in 155 functions (Battle_Command_Update, Casino_Slot_GetPatternRecordIndex), which pass the result to 0x63xxxx lookups.

name: g_gameWorkStorage
comment: Static BSS backing store for the 0x2FB28-byte GameWork singleton (object at 0x00804160, already 16-aligned); accessor Game_GetWork 0x006F20C0 (flag 0x007BE31C, holder *0x007BE320, vtable 0x00764B84). It contains the 31 PartyMember records (0x12EC bytes each) at +0x04, the item/save work at +0x24A98 and the per-game counters.
evidence: Game_GetWork (0x006F20C0) memsets 0x2FB28 bytes and runs std_ConstructArray(p+1, 0x0019244C, 0x12EC, 0x1F), i.e. the 31 PartyMember records; established fact: *0x007BE320 is the GameWork. 0x00804160+0x2FB28=0x00833C88, immediately before the UI subsystem storage 0x00833C98.

name: g_uiSubsystemWork
comment: Static BSS backing store for the UI subsystem's 0x80-byte state object (object at 0x00833CA0; flag 0x007BE324, holder *0x007BE328, vtable 0x007829CC, ctor 0x00384050). Ui_System_Update ticks it every frame, text measurement reads its overflow mask at +0x68 and sets flags at +0x6C, and Ui_Subsystem_Init hands it to Ui_LoadIconTextures.
evidence: Inlined lazy block in Ui_Subsystem_Init (0x001C5DD8), Ui_System_Update (0x001C60C0) and maybe_Text_MeasureOverflow (0x002FDEC8): memset 0x80 bytes at ALIGN_UP(0x00833C98,16), ctor 0x00384050 (clears +0x0C..+0x78, sets byte +0x7C=5), vtable 0x007829CC. 0x00833CA0+0x80=0x00833D20, before 0x00833D28.

name: g_fsCacheSetStorage
comment: Static BSS backing store for the 0x21C-byte FsCacheSet singleton (object at 0x00833D30; flag 0x007BE32C, holder *0x007BE330, vtable 0x007829E0, ctor 0x00122120). Engine_Initialize passes it to Fs_CacheSet_Initialize, and the per-frame Fs_CacheSet_UpdateEntries/Flush/Evict/Shutdown calls work on it; it owns the streaming pack caches (sound, weapon, PL/EN model+motion, UI).
evidence: Engine_Initialize (0x00101B74) creates it with size 0x21C, ctor 0x00122120 and vtable 0x007829E0, then calls Fs_CacheSet_Initialize(*0x007BE330); Fs_CacheSet_Flush/BeginEvict/EndEvict/UpdateEntries/Shutdown all take this pointer. 0x00833D30+0x21C=0x00833F4C, before 0x00833F78.

name: g_uiCoreStorage
comment: Static BSS backing store for the 0x98-byte UiCore singleton (object at 0x00833F80; accessor Ui_GetCore 0x006F229C, flag 0x007BE33C, holder *0x007BE340, vtable 0x00782A08). Every UI window/menu path reaches it: equip, camp, dive, fade-wipe, entry text and the message actor registrar.
evidence: Ui_GetCore (0x006F229C) memsets 0x98 bytes at ALIGN_UP(0x00833F78,16)=0x00833F80, calls Engine_ResourceNode_CtorBase, stores vtable 0x00782A08 and assigns *0x007BE340. 121 callers include Ui_EquipWindow_InitPanes, Ui_CampMenu_PushPane and MessageRegistActor.

name: g_inputPadStateStorage
comment: Static BSS backing store for the 0x1D4-byte input pad-state singleton (object at 0x00836F30; accessor Input_GetPadState 0x006F245C, flag 0x007BE36C, holder *0x007BE370, vtable 0x00782A98). Holds the current button bitmask at +0xC and the analog stick floats at +0x1C/+0x20 that the camera and cursor code read each frame.
evidence: Input_GetPadState (0x006F245C) reserves 0x1D4 bytes at ALIGN_UP(0x00836F24,16)=0x00836F30, memsets via 0x00116AE0 and runs ctor 0x001051F0 with vtable 0x00782A98. Camera_UpdateManualYaw and Ui_Cursor_ApplyRepeat inline the block and read *(float*)(*0x007BE370+0x1C).

name: g_gfxContextStorage
comment: Static BSS backing store for the 0x1348-byte GfxContext singleton (object at 0x00837150; accessor Gfx_GetContext 0x006F250C, flag 0x007BE384, holder *0x007BE388, vtable 0x007828EC). Owns the per-screen camera matrices, three 0xDC-byte material layers, UI draw lists, font pages and the screen fade/colour state; effect code also returns its render nodes to this object.
evidence: Gfx_GetContext (0x006F250C) memsets 0x1348 bytes at ALIGN_UP(0x00837148,16)=0x00837150 with vtable 0x007828EC and std_ConstructArray(p+1,0x005329E0,0xDC,3); 123 callers (CreateEffect2D, Ui_StartShiftFadeColor). Effect_Instance_ReleaseResources (0x0030B5F4) returns nodes to *0x007BE388.
